title: Served period envelope — the /api/period `statements` serve-time contract
description: Shape of the statements object AFTER the engine serve gateway (_reconcile.served_canonical_bs applied by pipeline._apply_envelope_truth_to_statements). This is the object the FE facts gateway (frontend/lib/servedFacts.ts) and the engine facts gateway (src/engine/serving/facts.py) both read. Totals here are the ADJUSTED (reconciliation-inclusive) figures on RECONCILED periods — the persisted source cents are never overwritten; the adjustment lives on a served copy plus the receipt. Shared fixture contract between tests/engine (test_envelope_contract.py validates every serving of every fixture against $defs/canonical_bs and snapshots the flattened field->type listing) and frontend/lib/__tests__. envelope_version below is the runtime stamp the serve path writes onto every served canonical_bs; x-envelope-version is the FE-side alias constant (frontend/lib/servedFacts.ts SERVED_ENVELOPE_VERSION) for the same contract generation. ANY field removal or retype requires bumping envelope_version AND appending a migration_notes entry here AND regenerating the engine schema snapshot (tests/engine/served_envelope_schema_snapshot.json).

migration_notes.note: Initial served-envelope contract. Serve path stamps envelope_version + status_presentation (engine.serving.present_status — the one wording authority; machine RECONCILED never presents as a 'balanced'-family label) + needs_review (boolean-when-not-array) + reconcile_offer onto every served canonical_bs. Additive-only serve guard active: serve mutations may add keys, never remove or retype pipeline-produced fields.

canonical_bs.description: canonical_bs v2 (docs/CANONICAL_BS_V2_CONTRACT.md), SERVED copy: the stored accepted reconciliation is already applied (status RECONCILED, difference 0, visible line + receipt) when its content_hash matches the period's source, and the sv1 serve stamps (envelope_version, status_presentation, needs_review, reconcile_offer) are present on EVERY serving. Render-verbatim; zero consumer arithmetic.

envelope_version.description: Runtime serve stamp — the served-envelope contract version this object conforms to (engine.serving.ENVELOPE_VERSION).

source_balanced.description: Per-pair D=C on the FILE's own numbers; null when not falsifiable (no totals row / pairs absent).

totals.description: Grand totals as served — reconciliation-ADJUSTED on RECONCILED periods. The single BS-totals authority for every surface, valuation equity included.

difference.description: assets − (equity + liabilities) as served; exactly 0 on RECONCILED.

reconcile_offer.description: Revised semantics (auto-reconcile addendum): true ONLY in the needs-review state; never renders a button.

needs_review.description: boolean true = auto-reconcile could not fix (needs manual mapping); array = AI-lane low-confidence lines.

consensus.description: DUAL-PATH CONSENSUS block (engine.consensus) — comparison metadata for two independent readings of one document. Additive and lane-specific (the hu_ai_lane optional-key precedent): absent on periods no consensus lane probed. Served values are NEVER taken from the second reading (E4 — classic/framing-A is always what rows/totals carry); value disagreements are flagged as review atoms, never silently resolved (E3). The three-leg verdict (dual_map_full_consensus AND totals_row_exact AND movement_checks_pass; a null movement leg fails closed) is THE E9 predicate gating BALANCED for extraction.method == 'mechanical_mapped'.

needs_review.description: Disagreement atoms in the ai_lane needs-review shape (code/name/amount/section/confidence/rationale/reason='consensus_disagreement' + source_ref). Kept INSIDE the consensus block on purpose — the top-level needs_review key keeps its two existing meanings untouched.

status_presentation.description: The ONE status-wording object (engine.serving.present_status) every surface — FE chip, HTML footer, Excel export, API — derives its status copy from. Machine RECONCILED NEVER maps to a 'balanced'-family display string in any language (locked by tests/engine/test_facts_gateway.py); the adjustment is disclosed via micro_caption ('auto-adjusted {X}').

trust_disclosure.description: Optional consensus trust line (engine.serving.status) — present ONLY when the served canonical_bs carries an ELIGIBLE consensus block (all three E9 legs green): deterministic + full consensus => 'Machine-computed · AI-verified (full)'; mechanical_mapped + E9 => 'Structure AI-interpreted · numbers machine-read · dual-verified'. Absent everywhere else (llm included).

reconciliation_receipt.description: Receipt served with status RECONCILED — the reversible synthetic entry's audit record. original_difference is the TRUE pre-adjustment source drift (the raw figure the audit/undo UI shows); applied_delta is the signed adjustment on the equity+liabilities side (== original_difference for an exact close).

assembled_bs_serve.description: Legacy assembled_bs view AFTER the serve gateway: on canonical_bs periods the 8 totals fields below are OVERWRITTEN from the served (adjusted) canonical totals; on legacy (pre-canonical) periods they come from methodology.totals. Bucket-level fields (cash, total_debt, ar_net, …) pass through unchanged and are NOT part of this totals contract.

public_summary.description: ps1 — reduced open-data tier (data.gov.ro mass bilant indicators, VERIFIED stable layout FY2019-FY2025: I1 Active imobilizate, I2 Active circulante, I6 Cheltuieli in avans, I7 DATORII, I10 CAPITALURI TOTAL — no separate capitaluri proprii, I13 Cifra de afaceri neta, I18 Profit net, I19 Pierdere neta, I20 Numar mediu salariati). A NEW top-level envelope kind: NEVER served through canonical_bs, never enters MACHINE_STATUSES / reconcile / consensus (PS1 structural refusals). Status is the parallel presentation token PUBLIC_SUMMARY; the FE gateway treats it as the null-verdict family (UNVERIFIED presentation). Indicators are EXACT whole-RON integers; absent = not reported (never 0). ADDITIVE to sv1 — no envelope_version bump required (additions need only a snapshot regen).

indicators.description: i-code -> whole-RON integer (can be negative); key absent when the source cell is empty. i-codes resolved per (year, file family) from the companion spec CSV — positional drift trap, never hard-coded.

derived.description: Ingest-precomputed derived figures (whole RON ints; ratios may be numbers). total_assets = I1 + I2 + I6; net_result = I18 - I19.

assembled_pl_serve.description: P&L serve additions. reconciliation_adjustment is present iff the period is RECONCILED with placement 'pnl' — the visible "Diferențe de reconciliere" line (signed effect on the result; extracted P&L cents never altered).
